classification.analysis: This is the owner's GitHub profile README repository (special `tbalt88/tbalt88` repo), containing a bio and portfolio summary of an AI enterprise architect building governed agentic AI systems (agentic-crm-support-architecture, houndstooth, memory-bridge-mcp, zero-to-hardened-agents, DexEvo Travel, Scanner), plus an auto-updated dashboard block injected daily by repo-tracker showing repo counts, fork-sync status, top languages, and recently updated repos. It functions purely as a personal landing page and portfolio index, not a runnable project.
